ValidationRule.description: Restrict Any Non Admin User To Edit on the PMG & Advanced Budgets Name Change Action
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PMG", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Advance_Budget" ), ISCHANGED(Name) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have necessary permissions to edit the Name of the Budget.
